biggest_catch: Betstamp pays its users nothing — it is a free odds-comparison and bet-tracking tool. Any 'promo' money comes from third-party sportsbooks where you must deposit and bet your own real money, which is gambling and can be lost.
catches: Betstamp itself offers no signup bonus, payout, or money to users — it is a companion tool, not a sportsbook
Its 'promotions' feature aggregates third-party sportsbook/DFS/casino promos; redeeming those requires real-money deposits and real bets on other platforms
Any real-money betting through the tools it links to is gambling: negative-sum after the sportsbook's vig, outcomes uncertain, addiction risk
Sportsbook promos carry their own terms (wagering requirements, expiry, state restrictions) set by the sportsbooks, not Betstamp

c1.evidence: Betstamp is real and operating: founded 2020 in Toronto; Google Play listing 'Betstamp: Bet Tracker & Props' (app.cashew.betstamp); 200+ sportsbooks/DFS/casino/sweepstakes sites integrated

c2.evidence: No official Betstamp terms page supports the catalog's 'sports promo' claim — the company describes its own product as free tools/tracking/promotions-aggregation, never its own payout

c3.evidence: No hidden upfront fee — the app is free ('Elevate Your Sports Betting Success for Free!')

c4.evidence: FAIL: no concrete user-facing money fact (exact promo amount, eligibility) exists in official Betstamp terms — Betstamp does not pay users

eligibility: Betstamp app itself: none stated. Third-party sportsbook promos it lists: 21+ (or state minimum), KYC, and state-specific availability set by each sportsbook
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Sources: Google Play store listing for 'Betstamp: Bet Tracker & Props' (elevate betting success for free; features: EV betting screen, odds comparison across sportsbooks, player prop research, line movement tracking, bet tracking, betting insights, community) and company descriptions (founded 2020 Toronto; 'we help develop winning bettors with tools, tracking, promotions, and analysis'). Key distinction: Betstamp's 'Betting Promotions' feature is an aggregator of other sites' promos, not a Betstamp payout. The catalog's 'sports promo, check current app' framing is misleading — nothing in official Betstamp materials promises the user money from Betstamp. If the route is kept, it must be reframed as a free betting-tools utility, with the gambling warning attached to the third-party sportsbooks it links to. Direct fetch of betstamp.app unavailable in this environment; evidence from official store listing and company-authored descriptions.
